Hey! It’s Tivadar from The Palindrome.
I’ve been working on my next video for quite a while. It’s one of my biggest projects yet. This time, I rebuilt the Liberty City map from the first installment of Grand Theft Auto — and decided to run thousands of simulations to study the dynamics of epidemics and the effect of control measures.
Even though the video is not yet ready, I want to give you an exclusive sneak peek! So, I decided to share two scenes from the video with you: the introduction and the part where I explain the infection dynamics and the SEIR model.
